title: Enoch's ascent and transformation into Metatron

tellings.quote: Enoch himself goes through this amazing personal transformation where he goes up to heaven, he walks with God, and then he turns into Medatron, this angel.

plain: Enoch, a figure from ancient Jewish scripture, is said to have gone up to heaven and walked with God, and then turned into an angel called Metatron. Michels tells this from the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text, in the translation by R. H. Charles. He brings it up as an example of a human being transformed by contact with the beings above.
